_comment: R-122 / R-124 (CL-BUG-130, CL-BUG-162): a call to a function name no tier
knows. The typechecker rejects this on the source path; --ir runs no
frontend at all, so this is how it reaches codegen.
Measured before the fix, same file through every --ir CLI:
go / ruby / python   compiled clean, script 00 — the OP_0 placeholder
The placeholder is not inert: it is pushed where the call's result belongs,
so it becomes the operand of the assert below. An unknown name therefore
compiled into an unconditionally FALSE spend instead of a rejected program.
